digest.component_or_area: development process audit and decision hygiene
propositions: Six process-improvement recommendations from the frozen audit must be evaluated against prior decisions, janitor remediations, and implementation outcomes before conversion to work tickets.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was already implemented as optional, present-only field at creation seams with 1.1% current coverage; the source audit queried tags instead of the actual field representation.
Deterministic plan preflight has a current P1-P11 mechanical floor shipped by prior decisions; new criteria require offline replay, false-positive ceiling, and fail-open behavior before promotion.

Completion-failure classification must derive categories from historical sidecars offline and validate agreement before adding schema; the 72.3% first-pass rate conflates defects, unmet ACs, missing evidence, and environmental failures.

Risk-tiered review should pilot reporting without merge enforcement, measure by actual defect/revert cohorts, and account for the fact that this project has no routine human review; prior precision-first calibration flagged 13 substantive changes among 113 larger diffs.
The soft 720-LOC debt warning is already shipped and complete; future debt work must avoid arbitrary quotas and prioritize near-cap size intersecting complexity, churn, or centrality.
